learning_objective: 🎯 Understand the importance of inclusivity in sports. Learn how adaptive physical education empowers Children With Special Needs (CWSN) to participate and excel!

main_concepts.simple_explanation: A specially designed program of developmental activities, games, and sports suited to the interests, capacities, and limitations of students with disabilities.
Disability is a restriction in ability to perform an activity (physical, cognitive, or sensory). Disorder is a disruption of regular bodily or mental functions (like ADHD or Autism).

Inclusion means providing all students, regardless of their disabilities, with equal opportunities to learn and play together in a regular physical education setting. It builds empathy and confidence.

Key organizations include the Paralympics (for athletes with physical disabilities), Special Olympics (for individuals with intellectual disabilities), and Deaflympics (for athletes with hearing impairments).
CWSN require support from a team: Counselors (mental health), Occupational Therapists (daily life skills), Physiotherapists (motor skills), and Special Educators.

fun_activity.title: 🧩 Modify the Game
fun_activity.instructions: Think of the game 'Basketball'. How would you modify it so a student in a wheelchair could play safely and fairly? (Ideas: Lower the hoop, allow them to hold the ball longer without dribbling). This is Adaptive PE!

exam_tips: 📌 Clearly differentiate between the 'Paralympics' (physical disabilities) and 'Special Olympics' (intellectual disabilities).
📌 List at least 3 ways to make sports inclusive (e.g., modifying equipment, changing rules, providing safe spaces).
📌 Understand the role of an Occupational Therapist (helps with fine motor skills and daily tasks) vs. a Physiotherapist (helps with gross motor skills and mobility).
quick_recap: ⭐ Sports are a universal language; everyone has the right to participate.
⭐ Adaptive sports modify the rules or equipment to fit the athlete, not the other way around.
⭐ Inclusion in PE promotes psychological well-being and social integration for CWSN.
